cases.title: First start builds the CLI image and the sandbox image in the background
steps: Start the stack as TESTING.md 'graph-manager' describes (build both packages, fake forge, server with temp dirs, log in, connect GitHub with gh-good, clone octo/hello), but first start the fake Docker: node apps/graph-manager/scripts/fake-docker.mjs $GM_DIR/docker.sock --build-delay 4000 & and add GM_DOCKER_SOCKET=$GM_DIR/docker.sock to the server env
Right after the server is up: curl -s -b $GM_DIR/c http://127.0.0.1:7420/api/sandbox/status
Wait 15 s (each fake build takes 4 s)
cases.expected: The first status answers at once with available:false, building:true, reason 'building the sandbox image'; the later one is available:true, building:false, defaultImage gm-sandbox:<12 hex>. The fake state has 2 builds: gm-sandbox-clis:<graph-manager version> whose Dockerfile runs npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code @openai/codex opencode-ai @qwen-code/qwen-code into /opt/gm-clis, then gm-sandbox:<hash> whose Dockerfile starts FROM node:24.22.1-bookworm, installs python3 and default-jdk-headless and copies /usr/local/go; both labelled gm.sandbox-image=1; one volume gm-clis-<12 hex> labelled gm.clis=1

cases.title: A sandboxed run mounts the CLI volume and puts it on PATH; no CLIs in the tools folder
steps: Start the stack as TESTING.md 'graph-manager' describes (build both packages, fake forge, server with temp dirs, log in, connect GitHub with gh-good, clone octo/hello), but first start the fake Docker: node apps/graph-manager/scripts/fake-docker.mjs $GM_DIR/docker.sock --build-delay 4000 & and add GM_DOCKER_SOCKET=$GM_DIR/docker.sock to the server env

Commit the engine fixture into the clone: cp -r packages/graph-execution/src/__fixtures__/diamond packages/graph-execution/src/__fixtures__/spec.md $GM_DIR/ws/github/octo/hello/ && git -C $GM_DIR/ws/github/octo/hello add -A && git -C $GM_DIR/ws/github/octo/hello -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@t commit -qm fixture
Wait until the status is available
cases.expected: The POST answers 201; the container gm-run-<runId> has Image gm-sandbox:<hash>, a mount {Type:volume, Name/Source gm-clis-<12 hex>, Destination /opt/gm-clis, RW false} next to /opt/gm-tools, and an Env entry starting PATH=/opt/gm-tools/bin:/opt/gm-clis/bin:; the tools folder has graph-execution, bin and VERSION but no lib folder

cases.title: Sandboxed runs wait for the build
steps: Start the stack as TESTING.md 'graph-manager' describes (build both packages, fake forge, server with temp dirs, log in, connect GitHub with gh-good, clone octo/hello), but first start the fake Docker: node apps/graph-manager/scripts/fake-docker.mjs $GM_DIR/docker.sock --build-delay 4000 & and add GM_DOCKER_SOCKET=$GM_DIR/docker.sock to the server env

Commit the engine fixture into the clone: cp -r packages/graph-execution/src/__fixtures__/diamond packages/graph-execution/src/__fixtures__/spec.md $GM_DIR/ws/github/octo/hello/ && git -C $GM_DIR/ws/github/octo/hello add -A && git -C $GM_DIR/ws/github/octo/hello -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@t commit -qm fixture

While the status says building: curl -s -w ' %{http_code}' -b $GM_DIR/c -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"tasksDir":"diamond","spec":"spec.md","provider":"fake","sandbox":true}' http://127.0.0.1:7420/api/runs/github~octo~hello
agent-browser: open http://127.0.0.1:7420/, log in, Runs -> Start run while building; screenshot the drawer; wait until the build ends and screenshot again
cases.expected: The POST answers 409 {error:'the sandbox image is building; try again when it is ready'}; the drawer's Run in sandbox switch is disabled with 'Building the sandbox image… (Settings → Sandbox)', and becomes enabled after the build without reopening the drawer

cases.title: The recipe is validated, and a change rebuilds only the sandbox image
steps: Start the stack as TESTING.md 'graph-manager' describes (build both packages, fake forge, server with temp dirs, log in, connect GitHub with gh-good, clone octo/hello), but first start the fake Docker: node apps/graph-manager/scripts/fake-docker.mjs $GM_DIR/docker.sock --build-delay 4000 & and add GM_DOCKER_SOCKET=$GM_DIR/docker.sock to the server env
Wait until the status is available
cases.expected: The GET has limits, recipe, defaultRecipe and dockerfile; the first PUT answers 400 'extraLines: FROM is not allowed; use COPY --from=<image>'; the second 400 'packages: Python3! is not a Debian package name'; the third 200 with a dockerfile containing 'apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends golang python3'; exactly one more build appears (a new gm-sandbox:<hash>, not the CLI image), the previous gm-sandbox image is gone from the fake's images, and the status defaultImage is the new tag

cases.title: Rebuild rebuilds both images without the cache
steps: Start the stack as TESTING.md 'graph-manager' describes (build both packages, fake forge, server with temp dirs, log in, connect GitHub with gh-good, clone octo/hello), but first start the fake Docker: node apps/graph-manager/scripts/fake-docker.mjs $GM_DIR/docker.sock --build-delay 4000 & and add GM_DOCKER_SOCKET=$GM_DIR/docker.sock to the server env
Wait until the status is available
cases.expected: The first POST answers 202 with build.state building; the second 409; GET /api/sandbox/build shows state building with a step and log lines; afterwards there are 2 more builds, both with nocache true, and a new gm-clis-<12 hex> volume replaces the old one

cases.title: A failed build is shown and blocks sandboxes until fixed
steps: Start the stack as TESTING.md 'graph-manager' describes (build both packages, fake forge, server with temp dirs, log in, connect GitHub with gh-good, clone octo/hello), but first start the fake Docker: node apps/graph-manager/scripts/fake-docker.mjs $GM_DIR/docker.sock --build-delay 4000 & and add GM_DOCKER_SOCKET=$GM_DIR/docker.sock to the server env
Wait until the status is available
agent-browser: open Settings, screenshot the Sandbox card
cases.expected: After the failing save the status is available:false with a reason starting 'the sandbox image build failed:'; the build state is failed with error 'fake build failed'; Settings shows failed, the error and the log; after the reset the status is available again

cases.title: A restart with the same version and recipe builds nothing
steps: Start the stack as TESTING.md 'graph-manager' describes (build both packages, fake forge, server with temp dirs, log in, connect GitHub with gh-good, clone octo/hello), but first start the fake Docker: node apps/graph-manager/scripts/fake-docker.mjs $GM_DIR/docker.sock --build-delay 4000 & and add GM_DOCKER_SOCKET=$GM_DIR/docker.sock to the server env
Wait until the status is available
Stop the server (not the fake Docker) and start it again with the same env
cases.expected: The status is available:true; the fake state still has only the 2 builds of the first start

cases.title: Settings → Sandbox image section in light and dark
steps: Start the stack as TESTING.md 'graph-manager' describes (build both packages, fake forge, server with temp dirs, log in, connect GitHub with gh-good, clone octo/hello), but first start the fake Docker: node apps/graph-manager/scripts/fake-docker.mjs $GM_DIR/docker.sock --build-delay 4000 & and add GM_DOCKER_SOCKET=$GM_DIR/docker.sock to the server env
Wait until the status is available
agent-browser: set viewport 1440 900, open Settings, screenshot the Sandbox card; expand the Dockerfile preview; add golang to Packages and click Save and rebuild; screenshot while building and after
Switch to dark (Settings -> Appearance -> Dark) and screenshot the card again
Set viewport 390 844 and screenshot the card
cases.expected: The card shows Base image, Packages (one per line, python3 among them), Extra Dockerfile lines with the COPY --from lines, the Dockerfile preview, Save and rebuild, Reset to defaults, Rebuild, the build state (building (image), then ready) and the log; text is readable in both themes and nothing overflows horizontally at phone width
